name: fiveai-skills
description: Validation tooling for the FiveAI multi-host skills plugin.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter fiveai-mcp run build && pnpm --filter fivem-plugin run build && node scripts/build-unified.mjs publish
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && node scripts/build-unified.mjs pack
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:mcp
